scenarios.title: An ability that says 'you get an emblem' puts a player-owned emblem in the command zone

setup.notes: Neither player has an emblem. A has not activated a loyalty ability this turn. Gideon is not summoning sick in any relevant way (planeswalker abilities have no tap cost).

decisions: A activates Gideon, Ally of Zendikar's loyalty ability [-4] (remove four loyalty counters as the cost): 'You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +1/+1."'
Gideon has 0 loyalty after the cost is paid and is put into A's graveyard by the state-based check before anyone receives priority.
B passes priority (in the base variant B does not respond).
A passes priority; the loyalty ability resolves.
In the 'countered' variant, B instead casts Stifle by tapping Island, targeting the [-4] ability on the stack; A passes priority and Stifle resolves first.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The ability resolves. A has one emblem in the command zone, owned and controlled by A and with no types, mana cost or color. A's Grizzly Bears is 3/3 and B's Grizzly Bears stays 2/2. Gideon is in A's graveyard (0 loyalty) and the emblem remains.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds by casting Stifle on the [-4] ability.
variants.expected: The ability is countered and does not resolve. Neither player has an emblem. A's Grizzly Bears stays 2/2 and B's Grizzly Bears stays 2/2. Gideon is in A's graveyard (0 loyalty, the cost was already paid) and Stifle is in B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the emblem as an Effect object (Duration$ Permanent) named 'Emblem — Gideon, Ally of Zendikar' in the command zone. Stifle can target it because its ValidTgts includes Card and Emblem.

scenarios.title: A triggered ability of an emblem triggers from the command zone

setup.notes: A has not yet played a land this turn. Neither player has an emblem at the start.

decisions: A activates Chandra, Torch of Defiance's loyalty ability [-7]: 'You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a spell, this emblem deals 5 damage to any target."' Chandra goes to 0 loyalty and to A's graveyard as a state-based action.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A gets the emblem.
A casts Shock targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain (the Mountain already on the battlefield).
The emblem's trigger goes on the stack above Shock, targeting player B.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves, then both players pass again and Shock resolves.
In the 'land' variant, A does not cast Shock; A plays the Mountain from hand as a land drop instead, and no further actions are taken.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The emblem's ability triggers when Shock is cast, even though Chandra is no longer on the battlefield. The trigger deals 5 damage to B (B at 15) and then Shock resolves: Grizzly Bears takes 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: land
variants.delta: A plays a land from hand instead of casting a spell.
variants.expected: The emblem's ability does not trigger because no spell was cast. B stays at 20 life, Grizzly Bears is undamaged, and Shock stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Chandra's script has Cost$ SubCounter<7/LOYALTY>; the setup needs a loyalty counters override of 7 on the battlefield card. The emblem is an Effect in the command zone whose Triggers$ TrigSpellCast has ValidActivatingPlayer$ You.

scenarios.title: A static ability of an emblem applies from the command zone after its source has left

setup.notes: Neither player has an emblem at the start. The two Grizzly Bears are the only creatures on the battlefield.

decisions: A activates Gideon, Ally of Zendikar's loyalty ability [-4]: 'You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +1/+1."' Gideon goes to 0 loyalty and to A's graveyard as a state-based action.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and A gets the emblem.
Read the board in the same main phase, with the stack empty. The variant 'opponents creature' reads B's Grizzly Bears instead of A's.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: With Gideon already in the graveyard, the emblem's static ability applies from the command zone: A's Grizzly Bears is 3/3.

variants.label: opponents_creature
variants.delta: The creature read is B's Grizzly Bears instead of A's.
variants.expected: B's Grizzly Bears is 2/2; the emblem's ability affects only creatures its controller (A) controls.

scenarios.forge_notes: The static ability lives on an Effect object in the command zone (StaticAbilities$ STPump with AffectedZone$ Battlefield).
